description.zh: App信息，代表一个业务配置
description.en: App information, representing a business configuration.

description.zh: 本次视频合成任务是否需要事件回调，默认false不回调。平台支持在任务开始和任务结束时进行事件回调，具体可参考文档：[数字人回调事件通知](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)。
description.en: Whether this video synthesis task requires an event callback. The default is false, meaning no callback. The platform supports event callbacks at the start and end of a task. For details, see [Digitized Virtual Human Callback Event Notifications]().

description.zh: 回调时需要透传的一些参数，json格式字符串，callback=false时不生效。
description.en: Parameters to pass through during the callback, in JSON string format. This parameter does not take effect when Callback is set to false.

description.zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
description.en: Tenant ID. Obtain the TenantId from the digitized virtual human Open Platform.

description.zh: 提交的视频合成的任务标题
description.en: The title of the submitted video synthesis task.

description.zh: 合成的视频需要的相关参数
description.en: Related parameters required for the synthesized video.

descriptions.zh: 该接口是针对有定制化视频合成样式的需求使用，正常的视频合成任务请直接使用：提交3D文本合成视频任务、提交3D语音合成视频任务、提交2D文本合成视频任务、提交2D语音合成视频任务即可。
descriptions.en: Use this API to customize video synthesis styles. For standard video synthesis tasks, use one of the following: Submit 3D Text-to-Video Synthesis Task, Submit 3D Speech-to-Video Synthesis Task, Submit 2D Text-to-Video Synthesis Task, or Submit 2D Speech-to-Video Synthesis Task.
